## Summary

What does this change and why?

## Checklist

- [ ] Formatting passes: `ruff format --check .`
- [ ] Linting passes: `ruff check .`
- [ ] Type check passes: `mypy src/pympacds` (or the service's package)
- [ ] Tests pass: `pytest`
- [ ] Complexity within limit: `lizard src -C 10`
- [ ] Tests added/updated for new behaviour
- [ ] Documentation updated (README / `doc/` / `debian/changelog`) where relevant
- [ ] Public API changes (if any) are reflected in the requirements
